criteria.title: Title accuracy
criteria.rule: Compare explicit title claims with the exact-SKU record.
criteria.remedy: Correct the title or ask the data steward to verify the specification.

criteria.title: Product capability
criteria.rule: Check explicit claims against the exact-SKU manufacturer record. Missing capability evidence requires clarification.
criteria.remedy: Revise the disputed bullet or provide an authoritative specification.

criteria.title: Product and color
criteria.rule: Images must accurately represent the product for sale. Compare the pictured product and color with this SKU.
criteria.remedy: Choose a matching photo verified for this variant.
criteria.verification: Public corroboration; confirm product-type exceptions in Seller Central

criteria.title: White studio background
criteria.rule: Check the US main image for a white background. This visual check approximates the published criterion.
criteria.verification: Public corroboration; confirm product-type exceptions in Seller Central

criteria.title: Added artwork on the main image
criteria.rule: US main images exclude added promotional text and graphics over the product or background. Integral branding is outside this overlay check.
criteria.remedy: Use the clean main photo. Ask for evidence if the mark may be physically on the product.
criteria.verification: Public corroboration; confirm product-type exceptions in Seller Central

criteria.title: Promotional guarantee wording
criteria.rule: US product bullets exclude promotional refund guarantees. The demonstration detects the phrase “Full refund”.
criteria.remedy: Remove the guarantee from the bullet.
criteria.verification: Public corroboration; confirm product-type exceptions in Seller Central

criteria.title: Variant and placement approval
criteria.rule: The digital asset library must verify the selected asset for this exact SKU and placement.
criteria.remedy: Select an approved asset or ask a steward to verify it.

criteria.title: Feed language
criteria.rule: This fictional merchant feed accepts English bullets. Compare the actual bullet language with its configured locale.
criteria.remedy: Resubmit English bullets to this feed.
